name: hdie_svc_stack_fault-hbmasvc-sf-COMMIT
purpose: HBM d4f stack fault glue sfault_<q> (x2, OWN_W=6 d4f binding): first kit. Structural CDC fix: the hbm->stream sticky classes ca/pc/owner cross through the audited ot_hbm_svc_fault_cdc (was an ad hoc two-flop level synchroniser, refused by the async_gray_fifo profile); reset pins land on ot_reset_sync; pin flops carry no reset. Outline 43.2 x 43.2 (pin-bound, slot 21.6 too small; reported to H-DIE).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hbm_svc_stack_fault #(.MUT(0), .OWN_W(6)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/loader/service_native/ot_hbm_svc_async_fifo.sv rtl/lib/ot_reset_sync.sv rtl/hbm_accel/loader/service_native/ot_hbm_svc_stack_fault.sv && echo lint-ok
